payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methodologies and metrics used to evaluate the quality of the data, including manual inspections, perplexity measurements, and similarity scores.

claims.text: The quality of the data is evaluated through manual inspections of translations, perplexity measurements, and similarity scores between transcripts and translations.
Quality checks for translations are performed, ensuring that poor quality translations are identified and corrected.
The evaluation includes calculating the ratio of English characters in translations and inspecting samples with low ratios.
